title: Production Lite reload lifecycle proof

scope.artChange: Validated the Lite sky quality split in the production server and repeated the same route three times to separate cache reuse from dev-mode noise.

validation.playwright: Chrome production server repeated loads: 3/3 completed, 0 failed requests

limitations: This proves one production Lite viewport and cache-reuse behavior; it is not a sustained FPS, GPU, or full device-matrix qualification.
Heap rose from 134.6 MB to 169.2 MB across reload observations; longer same-context soak and explicit lifecycle instrumentation remain open.
